meta.name: competitor-analysis
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "analyze competitors" or "竞品分析"; benchmarks competitor keywords, content, backlinks, AI citations, and traffic share into strengths, weaknesses, and an action plan. Not for a pairwise topic-coverage gap map — use content-gap-analysis. 竞品分析/竞争对手

copy.tagline: 分析竞品关键词、内容、流量，生成优劣势与行动方案。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想了解竞争对手的线上表现并制定应对策略。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会分析你指定的竞争对手网站，从关键词、内容、外链、AI 引用和流量份额等维度评估，输出一份包含优劣势和行动计划的报告。
howto.when: 当你要求“分析竞争对手”或“竞品分析”，或者给出竞争对手的网址时触发。

say.text: 分析竞争对手 example.com 的 SEO 策略。
say.note: Claude 会生成一份完整的竞品分析报告。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude analyzes competitor websites across keywords, content, backlinks, AI citations, and traffic share, producing a report with strengths, weaknesses, and an action plan.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to "analyze competitors" or "竞品分析", or provide a competitor URL.

say_en.note: Claude generates a full competitor analysis report.

say_en.text: Compare my site mysite.com against competitor1.com and competitor2.com.
